corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. Measured centres of the pairs: heads 102.74, inner legs 102.75, outer legs 102.83, forearm uprights 102.65, table ends 102.94. Moves are 0.2 px or less, except the right table end (0.37 px).

corrections.what: Drew each shoulder as a quarter circle on the outer side (r 16.5) and one cubic curve on the inner side, from the top of the shoulder to the open end above the forearm bar
corrections.why: The outer shoulder fits a circle with rms under 0.01 px (r 16.51 and 16.61). The inner shoulder is a long, flattening curve that no circle or ellipse fits; a cubic with fixed end tangents fits it with rms 0.06 px. The two sides' fits were averaged so the figures mirror exactly.

source_notes: Kept: each figure's inner contour stops open above the forearm bar; the outer sides lean slightly outward to the table top (4.4 deg) as drawn; the forearm bar is one U whose uprights stop below the inner contour ends.
